info.name: RapidAPI - Auto Parts Catalog
info.description: Auto Parts Catalog (TecDoc-based) endpoints exposed via RapidAPI MCP. Generated from the opencode MCP tool definitions. Set RAPID_API_KEY collection variable before running requests. Common IDs: typeId=1 (Passenger cars), langId=16 (EN)/22 (TR), countryFilterId=1 (TR)/2 (DE)/11 (NL).
